cause: validateAlterStylingDesignProps runs in ValidateProgram with no document, so it asked only whether ANY widget type declares the key; the widget's $Type lives in the stored page.
file: mdl/executor/validate_alter_styling_stored.go (validateAlterStylingStoredTypes, reference pass, wired in validate.go); validate_alter_set.go (pageProbe now embeds widgetStorageTyper); design_property_routing.go (designPropsKeyOfStored, documentThemeOf). insight: **The first attempt passed every mock-backend test and did nothing on a real project:** it opened the page from ValidateProgram's lazy project, and openProjectForValidation's read-only modelsdk connection refuses OpenPageForMutation ("not connected for writing") — MockBackend's OpenPageForMutationFunc does not, so only `check -p` against a real 11.14.0 app showed the precise path silently falling back. Anything that opens a document for a check belongs in the reference pass (validateProgramWithWarnings, implied by -p and run by exec's preflight), which validateAlterSetProperties and validateStoredSnippetCallAppearance already use. Split by KEY to avoid double reports: the any-type pass keeps keys no type declares, the stored pass judges only keys the first accepted, with validateDesignPropsAs's exact condition (findThemeProp, rename, declaresGroup guard) so ALTER STYLING and CREATE PAGE cannot disagree. No new resolver: designPropsKeyOfStored is storedWidgetDesignPropsKey's body, shared.
